requirements.reason: The accepted authorization matrix must remain the source of truth for the 11 self-owned account, notification, inbox, saved-card, credit, payment, refund, and host-fee route families and 28 B-owned route keys.

Current-account routes must bind reads and mutations to the authenticated local user from the Firebase bearer token, with no caller-selected target user for /auth/me, /users/me, /user-settings/me, /user-stats/me, profile/settings updates, or self-delete.

B-owned ordinary behavior must preserve the accepted distinction between authenticated app user, active user, recent-authenticated user, and provider-verified email, without inventing a verified-email requirement for ordinary B-owned self behavior.

Notification and inbox routes must be current-user scoped: notification lists/counts filter to the current user, foreign notifications are concealed without read-state side effects, selected platform notices require a current-user recipient row, and global-seen updates require a valid signed token for the current user.

Saved-card routes must be current-user scoped, provider SetupIntent and payment-method customer IDs must match the current user's stored Stripe customer, and default/detach actions must preserve recent-auth and reject wrong-owner cards before provider mutation.

Ordinary-user financial reads must not be widenable through query filters or object IDs: payments remain scoped to payer, refunds through payment payer, game-credit balance/list to the current user unless admin, and host-publish-fee /me to host_user_id.

Admin exceptions visible in current B-adjacent services must not be converted into B closure; B proves ordinary users cannot gain admin breadth and leaves final admin/high-risk review to WS03-04D or later named owners.

Negative proof must cover 401 unauthenticated/invalid-credential behavior, 403 forbidden behavior, 404 concealed foreign-resource behavior, cross-user object and filter denials, wrong signed token/customer/card ownership, stale recent-auth, caller-controlled field attempts, and no prohibited side effects for rejected mutations.

The B trusted evidence, requirement declaration, testing record, and execution-register update must remain traceable, current, and scoped to accepted repository source and tests without backend/tests/legacy or deferred-governance false mappings.

Live or deployed provider proof, Stripe dashboard proof, durable payment/refund reconciliation, genuine database-concurrency closure, admin/high-risk final review, export/unmask/read-audit policy, and WS03-04C relationship authorization are outside WS03-04B and must have zero local pytest mappings in this pass.
